rundown: Knights beat Cyclones 48-17 at Acrisure Bounce House in Orlando, FL. Knights led 24-10 at the half and never looked back. The 4th quarter decided it: Knights won it 17-0.
Scoring: Cyclones 2 touchdowns and 1 field goal; Knights 6 touchdowns and 2 field goals. The last score: A. Barnett III pass to J. Maiava for 5 yds, for a TD (W. Stone KICK) (4th quarter, 6:35).

Leading the way — Cyclones: Jaylen Raynor 14/23, 109 yds, 1 INT; Aiden Flora 23 car, 171 yds, 2 TD; Omari Hayes 2 rec, 29 yds. Knights: Alonza Barnett III 17/27, 255 yds, 4 TD; Duke Watson 16 car, 113 yds; Josh Derry 4 rec, 125 yds, 3 TD.
Where Knights won it: they outgained them 460 yards to 298, won the turnover battle (0 to 4) and held the ball 32:45 to 27:15.
Against the closing line (DraftKings): Cyclones closed as 1.5-point favorites and lost outright to Knights; the total closed at 50.5 and they combined for 65, over by 14.5.

review.title: The algo's call
review.body:
Logged before the start, last snapshot Nov 20, 5:57 PM ET. It had Cyclones 54% and Knights 46%, projecting Cyclones 26.1 – Knights 24.4 (50.5 total, Cyclones by 1.7).

Final: Cyclones 17 – Knights 48. Wrong winner: it had Cyclones at 54%, and Knights (46%) won.

review.title: How the ratings held up
review.body:
Cyclones came in with a 8% above average attack and a 7% stingier than average defense (5-5, 30.4 scored and 27.3 allowed a game over 10 games), worth about 183 and 188 games of evidence. Projected to score 26.1, they scored 17 (−9.1 points, 35% under); projected to allow 24.4, they allowed 48 (+23.6 points, 96% over).

Knights came in with a league-average attack and a 4% stingier than average defense (5-5, 28.4 scored and 26 allowed a game over 10 games), worth about 183 and 185 games of evidence. Projected to score 24.4, they scored 48 (+23.6 points, 96% over); projected to allow 26.1, they allowed 17 (−9.1 points, 35% under).

The bigger miss was Knights' scoring (+23.6 points against projection).

review.title: Where the result sat in the simulations
review.body:
Total: 65 against 50.5 projected (+14.5), about the 82nd percentile of the simulated totals (a typical game swings ±15.5).

Margin: Knights by 31 against Cyclones by 1.7 projected, about the 98th percentile of the simulated margins (typical swing ±15.3).

An outlier: the simulations had a result this far off less than about 5% of the time, which usually means an input was wrong or missing, not just bad luck.

review.title: Situational factors, checked
review.body: Weather (72°F · ? mph wind): Knights ×0.94, Cyclones ×0.94. Market (Line movement signal): Knights ×1.00, Cyclones ×1.02. It favored Cyclones, who did not beat their projection by more than the other side did.

review.title: Against the market
review.body:
UCF ML (+100) at +100: the algo gave it 48% vs 48% fair (-0.2 pts) — won (+1u); lost to the close (closing fair chance 49%). ISU ML (-120) at -120: the algo gave it 52% vs 52% fair (+0.2 pts) — lost (-1u); lost to the close (closing fair chance 51%). UCF +1.5 (-110) at -110: the algo gave it 50% vs 50% fair (0 pts) — won (+0.9u); same number as the close. ISU -1.5 (-110) at -110: the algo gave it 50% vs 50% fair (+0 pts) — lost (-1u); same number as the close. OVER 50.5 (-110) at -110: the algo gave it 49% vs 50% fair (-1 pts) — won (+0.9u); same number as the close. UNDER 50.5 (-110) at -110: the algo gave it 51% vs 50% fair (+1 pts) — lost (-1u); same number as the close.

The line barely moved between the algo's snapshot and the close.

No bet: nothing cleared the algo's bar before the game.

review.title: Where the public and the money were
review.body:
Splits (Action Network): spread: 62% of bets on Cyclones, 76% of the money — Knights covered; total: 58% of bets on the over, 59% of the money — it went over; moneyline: 39% of bets on Cyclones, 79% of the money.

The sharp side by the algo's read was Cyclones, who lost and didn't cover.

review.title: What the algo learns
review.body:
This game's own lesson: scoring came in at ×1.207 of the raw projection, and the home side beat its projected margin by +31.4 points. It counts toward CFB scoring level, home edge and both teams' attack and defense corrections.

Across 137 graded CFB games the algo now scales scoring ×0.940 and gives home teams -1.2 points. Team corrections so far: Cyclones attack ×1.040, defense ×1.032 (3 games); Knights attack ×1.023, defense ×1.000 (3 games).

review.title: Bottom line
review.body: Wrong side, total within its normal range, margin outside its normal range (off by 32.7 points), no bet.
